user.title: Sign in to Brightwheel
user.description: Enter your Brightwheel email and password. If your account has 2FA enabled, you'll be asked for a code next.

two_factor.title: Two-factor code
two_factor.description: Enter the code Brightwheel just emailed you.

qr.title: Daycare QR data
qr.description: Scan the daycare QR with any QR reader and paste the decoded JSON here (must contain school_id and secret).

student.title: Pick a child
student.description: Select which student + room this integration entry should manage.

data.child_name: Display name (optional, defaults to student name)

error.auth: Sign-in failed — check email, password, and 2FA code.
error.bad_qr: Could not parse QR data — expected JSON with school_id + secret.
error.students_fetch: Couldn't load students for that QR. Check the QR is for this daycare and you're signed in to the right account.
error.no_students: No students were returned for that QR.

checkin.name: Check in
checkin.description: Check the configured child into daycare.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Only required if multiple Brightwheel entries are configured.

checkout.name: Check out
checkout.description: Check the configured child out of daycare.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Only required if multiple Brightwheel entries are configured.
